Name: Ship Anything
Author: berkay2578
Description:
[center][b][size=4]Still works as of March 2026![/size][/b][/center]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/4P4nbwQ/about.png[/img]
This mod lets you put anything into the shipping bin. This includes: boots, rings, tools (pickaxe, axe, etc.), weapons (swords, slingshots, etc.), furniture, wallpapers. Works with existing saves.

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/Vgy1wLs/how-to-install.png[/img][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url][b].[/b]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into "[i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]".
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*][font=Arial][size=1]Endorse the mod if you liked it. :)[/size][/font]
[/list]
Check out my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8808]Infinite Zoom[/url]! It lets you change zoom and UI scale levels infinitely.

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/g9GG0Xx/technical-stuff.png[/img][/b]
[list]
[*]Works with the latest version of Stardew Valley.
[*]Works in both single-player and multiplayer.
[*]No mod conflicts. (As far as I am aware)
[*]No custom prices are given to the items, this mod only uses the values supplied by Stardew Valley itself.
[/list][url=https://github.com/berkayylmao/StardewValleyMods]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/ssv0c69/source-code.png[/img][/url]﻿
